prompt: Some people say that technological gadgets like smart phones have made life easier and more convenient. Other people say that they have made life more complex and stressful. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Technological gadgets, especially smartphones, have become central to modern life. Some people believe these devices have made daily activities simpler and more convenient, while others argue that they have increased pressure and complexity. In my opinion, smartphones are extremely useful, but they can become stressful when people use them without limits. This essay will discuss both views before explaining why their benefits generally outweigh their disadvantages.

To begin with, smart devices have made many aspects of life easier. For example, people can now communicate instantly, manage bank accounts, book transport, study online, and find directions using one small device. As a result, tasks that once required time, travel, or paperwork can now be completed within minutes. Therefore, gadgets have improved efficiency and given people greater control over their daily routines.

However, these same devices can also make life more demanding. For instance, constant notifications, work emails, social media updates, and online messages can make people feel that they must always be available. Moreover, many users compare their lives with idealised images online, which can increase anxiety and dissatisfaction. Consequently, smartphones may blur the boundary between work and personal life, creating mental pressure instead of freedom.

In conclusion, technological gadgets have brought both convenience and stress to modern society. Nevertheless, I believe they have made life better overall because they save time, improve communication, and expand access to services. People should therefore learn to control their screen time and use technology as a tool rather than allowing it to control their lives.
